messages:
julia: Opening a quick thread for the docs PR that migrates console observability examples to metrics_v2. Found: 1) heatmap example link 404, 2) tracing snippet drops empty trace_key, 3) embedding snippet uses old cost field.
andre: drop the PR link when ready, I can pick up the link redirect.
mike: note about span_sampling: schema changed from 'true/false' to object. We should add a migration note.
ci-bot: examples job failed: TypeError in sample-renderer: expected str for trace_key but got None.
julia: repro snippet attached in PR: `tracehook: { trace_key: null, span_sampling: true }` - propose `trace_key: ""` and `span_sampling: { strategy: "probabilistic", rate: 0.01 }`.
andre: I'll replace the dead URL with https://console.redwood.ai/playground and file REDW-1190 for infra redirect.
docs-bot: Suggested doc edit: update embed snippets to use `unit_cost.tokens` instead of `cost_per_token`.
julia: added checklist in PR, manual smoke test queued. Please review when CI green.
mike: approving once CI passes, left one nit on wording in migration note.
ci-bot: CI re-run triggered by @julia.
julia: merged after fixes. Opening follow-up task REDW-1191 to sweep SDK samples for cost field renames. Thanks all!
